headlessSequence: create-save: factory startup, verify typed defaults, invoke create_shot, save persistence blend, exit
reopen: launch a new process with the saved blend and verify exact typed and selected-camera state
missing-prepare: launch the persistence blend, remove optional Shot and camera state, save a separate blend, exit
missing-reopen: launch a new process with missing optional state, verify core state, invoke create_shot, and verify recovery

visibleUiSequence.startup: Launch the exact built app after a fresh 160 GiB admission and dismiss only non-task splash/setup surfaces
visibleUiSequence.task: Verify native Project, Scene, Shot and Character start surface, then click Create Shot exactly once
visibleUiSequence.strictComparison: F0 actual interactions must be less than official actual interactions (24)
visibleUiSequence.expertRoundtrip: Click Expert Mode, verify complete Blender menus/workspace tabs and the same open scene, then click Film Mode and verify the same typed state without conversion

stopRule: Any failed admission starts zero native processes. Any failed identity, hash, operator, persistence, optional-state, UI, interaction-count, or isolation check produces FAIL rather than relaxing acceptance.
